title: Orange glazed gammon with sprouting broccoli

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, butter, mustard, gammon, oil, broccoli, garlic, orange and honey are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Gammon steaks and purple sprouting broccoli are both everyday lines at Tesco in February.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, a lidded frying pan and a masher, with simple boiling, frying and steaming.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, the gammon timing is sensible, and seasoning with pepper only rightly allows for the salty gammon.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes of active work covers halving potatoes, slicing garlic, juicing the orange and frying, and the 20-minute cook matches the potato boil.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears apart from water, and 'sprouting broccoli' is the same food as its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Early purple sprouting broccoli with a warm glazed gammon and crushed potatoes suits a February evening, and 400g of broccoli is a real part of the plate, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, brief British instructions a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Gammon, potatoes and a good portion of greens make a proper family dinner.
